state_analysis: The analysis report has been created successfully. Now I need to create the optimized logrotate configuration file and the CSV summary.
explanation: Create the optimized logrotate configuration file with proper rotation schedules, compression, and retention policies for all log files.

commands.keystrokes:
cat > /app/optimized_logrotate.conf << 'EOF'
# Optimized Logrotate Configuration
# Generated by Log Rotation Analyzer
# Addresses: disk space issues, inconsistent rotation, missing compression

# Application Log - High importance, 15.2 MB/day growth, 30 day retention
/var/log/samples/app.log {
    daily
    rotate 30
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    maxsize 100M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    postrotate
        # Reload application if needed
        /usr/bin/killall -HUP web-server 2>/dev/null || true
    endscript
}

# System Log - Critical importance, 2.1 MB/day growth, 90 day retention
/var/log/samples/system.log {
    daily
    rotate 90
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 root adm
    maxsize 50M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
}

# Access Log - Medium importance, 45.7 MB/day growth, 14 day retention
/var/log/samples/access.log {
    daily
    rotate 14
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    maxsize 50M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/killall -USR1 nginx 2>/dev/null || true
    endscript
}

# Error Log - Critical importance, 8.9 MB/day growth, 60 day retention
# NOTE: Previously had NO rotation configuration - CRITICAL FIX
/var/log/samples/error.log {
    daily
    rotate 60
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    maxsize 50M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/killall -HUP web-server 2>/dev/null || true
    endscript
}

# Debug Log - Low importance, 5.3 MB/day growth, 7 day retention
# NOTE: Previously had NO rotation configuration
/var/log/samples/debug.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    maxsize 25M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
}
EOF
